ios.desc:
Train your brain in 5 minutes a day.

10 Games gives you ten quick, fun brain games every day, built to sharpen your memory, math, words, speed and focus. Play your daily ten, see how you did, and watch yourself improve over time.

YOUR DAILY TEN
Every day brings a fresh set of ten short games covering every skill. Finish them in about five minutes, keep your streak going, and see your score, your change from yesterday and your personal bests.

68 BRAIN GAMES
Play any time, as much as you like:
• Memory: remember words, patterns, pairs and sequences
• Math: quick sums, number lines and number puzzles
• Words: word wheels, anagrams, definitions and vocabulary
• Speed: reaction tests and fast-paced challenges
• Logic and focus: 3D chess puzzles, Water Sort, Arrow Away, Cube Count, Route to Safety, Sudoku and more
• Quizzes: thousands of trivia and true or false questions

FIND YOUR BRAIN AGE
Play three quick games to discover your Brain Age, then train every day to bring it down.

TAKE THE IQ TEST
A full 24-question IQ test across six areas: pattern, spatial, verbal, math, memory and logic. Thousands of questions keep every test fresh, with beautiful visuals and a detailed report of your strengths.

LEVEL UP
Earn XP for everything you play and climb from Novice to Legend. Reach Bronze to Diamond in each skill and collect 60 badges for streaks, milestones and personal bests.

COMPETE WITH THE WORLD
See where people train on a live globe, check your global rank in brain training and the IQ test, and compare yourself with your country and the world.

PLAY TOGETHER
Seven 2-player games for one device, with names, scores, rematches and swap sides. Perfect for friends and family.

BUILD A HABIT
• A real day streak, with Streak Freeze for Pro members
• A weekly recap every Sunday
• Home Screen widgets
• Gentle reminders that stop once you've trained
• Daily Sudoku, Word of the Day and Fact of the Day


10 Games is made by an independent developer. Thank you for playing, and if you enjoy it, a rating means the world.
Works offline - no wifi needed. Built with love by an independent developer. Thank you for playing!


Let's celebrate! This is my 10th Game (Hence The Name!)! Thank YOU all so much for playing!

quotes.text:
Hi I am Tai and I have been building apps for the past 10 years and this is my tenth game, hence the name!

Ever since the surge of brain training games on the Nintendo DS, I wanted to create something that would be not only fun but engaging and also educational that everyone could use.

I wanted to build a super simple set of brain training games that you could play everyday and see how you compare with people from across the world.

The main games comprises of 10 super simple brain training games that test your reactions, memory, mental maths etc the game takes about 5-10 minutes to complete.

When finished you are given a score and you can see how you performed against users from around the world! The leaderboard resets every midnight!

The app was created all in SwiftUI and is 100% native.

See you on the leaderboards!
